collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.
collection.description: A newcomer's name has a sound that is unfamiliar on Isola, and most villagers have been saying it wrong.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A newcomer's name has a sound that is unfamiliar on Isola, and most villagers have been saying it wrong.

choices.label: Ask How to Say It Correctly.
Practice It Privately Until It Is Right.
Encourage Others to Learn It Too.
Ask the Newcomer What They Like to Be Called.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The newcomer is pleased and patiently teaches the right sound.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The newcomer says the close version is fine, but appreciates being asked.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The next time the villager says it, the newcomer smiles warmly.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The villager still struggles a little, but the effort is noticed.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Soon most villagers say it properly.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some villagers forget, and the villager gently reminds them.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The newcomer shares a nickname they love.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The newcomer prefers the full name, said correctly, and the villager makes a point of it.
